items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Well, here's an old man Allen stand.

ctx.x: Oh, they had a, let's see, I see the uniform. They had a blue, a blue, a blue suit, blue sewage, you know, with a little short collar and a sardine glove, black trivet. I see the pictures there where they had a uniform. And the Eureka, they had the black pants and the white shirts.
Well, here's an old man Allen stand. Would the tuxedo thing look like that? Old man Allen stand. Would they have those kind of collars and everything?

Oh, yeah, yeah, that's right. That was a bad uniform. Yeah, that's the kind of uniform it had. That's the correct. You ain't got none of them there with the fireman caps there. Let's see if they, look at this.
